title: Skateboarding Without Limits | PlayLA's Adaptive Skateboarding Program
description:
Skateboarding has no limits—and neither do the people discovering just how far they can go. 🛹💙

Through the PlayLA initiative, the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks' Ability Skateboarding and Action Sports program is making skateboarding accessible to participants of all ages and abilities. Whether someone is blind, deaf, uses a wheelchair, or is stepping onto a skateboard for the first time, the program provides the equipment, instruction, and encouragement needed to build confidence in a supportive environment.

Featured in this segment is Coco Atama, also known as Blind Thrasher, who describes himself as the world's only blind and autistic professional skateboarder.

From skateboards and protective gear to adaptive equipment and one-on-one coaching, participants simply need to show up. 

Learn more about PlayLA Youth and Adaptive Youth Sports Program offered by the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks at https://recreation.parks.lacity.gov/
